label: ShiftWorkspace
prompt: Create a readable dated roster with clear staff commitments, locations, roles, and conflicts. Keep coverage requirements and published duties distinct from private leave information; make swap decisions and notification outcomes easy to follow. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
